title: Warm Wilted Mexican Tortilla Fried Chips
description: A sweet, light, and show-off Mexican (Oaxacan) dish featuring allspice, dehydrated, and gluten-free-friendly ingredients in the form of chilaquiles.
instructions: Dehydrate the corn tortillas in a low-temperature oven (150°F) for 2 hours, or until crispy and lightweight.
Cut the dehydrated tortillas into quarters and place them in a large bowl.
In a separate pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat (350°F).
Fry the tortilla quarters in batches until crispy and golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer the fried chips to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a medium saucepan, combine the allspice, cinnamon, granulated sugar, and kosher salt. Heat over low heat (275°F) for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the heavy cream to the saucepan and stir until the mixture is smooth and well combined.
Add the fried tortilla chips to the saucepan and toss to coat with the spiced cream mixture.
Stir in the diced onion, dehydrated apple, crumbled cotija cheese, and chopped cilantro.
Transfer the warm, wilted chilaquiles to a serving dish and serve with lime wedges on the side.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
